43678-anne-of-geierstein-or-the-maiden-o.title: Anne Of Geierstein
43678-anne-of-geierstein-or-the-maiden-o.creator: Sir Walter Scott, Bart.
43678-anne-of-geierstein-or-the-maiden-o.description: A book by Sir Walter Scott, Bart.. With "The Fair Maid of Perth" we take farewell of Scott at his best, though "even from the stubble one may tell what the grain has been." "Anne of Geierstein" was no favourite of the author's, and, as Mr. Matthew Arnold says, the world does not contemplate with pleasure what the poet creates without joy.

8730-a-little-bush-maid.title: A Little Bush Maid
8730-a-little-bush-maid.creator: Mary Grant Bruce
8730-a-little-bush-maid.description: A book by Mary Grant Bruce. The creepers had had time to twine round the massive posts in those fifteen years, and some even lay in great masses on the verandah roof; tecoma, pink and salmon-coloured; purple bougainvillea, and the snowy mandevillea clusters. Hard-headed people said this was not good for the building—but Norah’s mother had planted them, and because she had loved them they were never touched.

arxiv-1602-07260.title: When Is a Local Homeomorphism a Semicovering Map?
arxiv-1602-07260.creator: Majid Kowkabi, Behrooz Mashayekhy, Hamid Torabi
arxiv-1602-07260.description: Abstract In this paper, by reviewing the concept of semicovering maps, we present some conditions under which a local homeomorphism becomes a semicovering map. We also obtain some conditions under which a local homeomorphism is a covering map. 2010 MSC 57M10, 57M12, 57M05 1 Introduction It is well-known that every covering map is a local homeomorphism.

arxiv-2011-05526.title: The mode switching in pulsar J1326 − - 6700 Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2011-05526.creator: Z. G. Wen, W. M. Yan, J. P. Yuan, H. G. Wang, J. L. Chen, M. Mijit, R.Yuen, N. Wang, Z. Y. Tu, S. J. Dang
arxiv-2011-05526.description: Abstract We report on a detailed study on the mode switching in pulsar J1326 − - 6700 by analysis the data acquired from the Parkes 64-m radio telescope at 1369 MHz. During the abnormal mode, the emission at the central and trailing components becomes extremely weak.

arxiv-2106-05130.title: IoT Solution for Winter Survival of Indoor Plants
arxiv-2106-05130.creator: Md Saroar Jahan, Jhuma kabir Mim, Sampo Niittyviita, Santeri Moberg, Murad Ahmad, Nijar Hossain
arxiv-2106-05130.description: Abstract Not only does cold climate pose a problem for outdoor plants during winter in the northern hemisphere, but for indoor plants as well: low sunlight, low humidity, and simultaneous cold breezes from windows and heat from radiators all cause problems for indoor plants.

arxiv-2203-11933.title: A Prompt Array Keeps the Bias Away: Debiasing Vision-Language Models with Adversarial Learning
arxiv-2203-11933.creator: Hugo Berg, Siobhan Mackenzie Hall, Yash Bhalgat, Wonsuk Yang
arxiv-2203-11933.description: Abstract Vision-language models can encode societal biases and stereotypes, but there are challenges to measuring and mitigating these multimodal harms due to lacking measurement robustness and feature degradation. To address these challenges, we investigate bias measures and apply ranking metrics for image-text representations.

arxiv-2303-06451.title: Generation and control of localized terahertz fields in photoemitted electron plasmas
arxiv-2303-06451.creator: Eduardo J. C. Dias, I. Madan, S. Gargiulo, F. Barantani, M. Yannai, G. M. Vanacore, I. Kaminer, F. Carbone, F. Javier García de Abajo
arxiv-2303-06451.description: Abstract Dense micron-sized electron plasmas, such as those generated upon irradiation of nanostructured metallic surfaces by intense femtosecond laser pulses, constitute a rich playground to study light-matter interactions, many-body phenomena, and out-of-equilibrium charge dynamics. Besides their fundamental interest, laser-induced plasmas hold potential for the generation of localized terahertz radiation pulses.

arxiv-2305-00622.title: Folding-Free ZNE: A Comprehensive Quantum Zero-Noise Extrapolation Approach for Mitigating Depolarizing and Decoherence Noise
arxiv-2305-00622.creator: Hrushikesh Pramod Patil, Peiyi Li, Ji Liu, Huiyang Zhou
arxiv-2305-00622.description: Abstract Quantum computers in the NISQ era are prone to noise. A range of quantum error mitigation techniques has been proposed to address this issue. Zero-noise extrapolation (ZNE) stands out as a promising one. ZNE involves increasing the noise levels in a circuit and then using extrapolation to infer the zero noise case from the noisy results obtained.

arxiv-2312-11930.title: InPTC: Integrated Planning and Tube-Following Control for Prescribed-Time Collision-Free Navigation of Wheeled Mobile Robots
arxiv-2312-11930.creator: Xiaodong Shao, Bin Zhang, Hui Zhi, Jose Guadalupe Romero, Bowen Fan, Qinglei Hu, David Navarro-Alarcon
arxiv-2312-11930.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xiaodong Shao, Bin Zhang, Hui Zhi, Jose Guadalupe Romero, Bowen Fan, Qinglei Hu, David Navarro-Alarcon. In this article, we propose a novel approach, called InPTC (Integrated Planning and Tube-Following Control), for prescribed-time collision-free navigation of wheeled mobile robots in a compact convex workspace cluttered with static, sufficiently separated, and convex obstacles.

arxiv-2404-17624.title: Phase transitions, critical behavior and microstructure of the FRW universe in the framework of higher order GUP
arxiv-2404-17624.creator: Zhong-Wen Feng 1, Shi-Yu Li 1, Xia Zhou 1, Haximjan Abdusattar 2
arxiv-2404-17624.description: Abstract In this paper, we explore the phase transition, critical behavior and microstructure of the FRW in the framework of a new higher order generalized uncertainty principle (GUP). Our initial step involves deriving the equation of state by defining the work density W W from GUP corrected Friedmann equations as the thermodynamic pressure P P .

arxiv-2411-07955.title: How to discover short, shorter, and the shortest proofs of unsatisfiability: a branch-and-bound approach for resolution proof length minimization
arxiv-2411-07955.creator: Konstantin Sidorov k.sidorov@tudelft.nl, Gonçalo Homem de Almeida Correia G.Correia@tudelft.nl, Mathijs de Weerdt m.m.deweerdt@tudelft.nl
arxiv-2411-07955.description: Abstract Modern software for propositional satisfiability problems gives a powerful automated reasoning toolkit, capable of outputting not only a satisfiable/unsatisfiable signal but also a justification of unsatisfiability in the form of resolution proof (or a more expressive proof), which is commonly used for verification purposes.

arxiv-2502-01365.title: Fifteen Years of M31* X-ray Variability and Flares
arxiv-2502-01365.creator: Stephen DiKerby, Shuo Zhang, Jimmy Irwin
arxiv-2502-01365.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Stephen DiKerby, Shuo Zhang, Jimmy Irwin. We append an additional fifteen years (2009-2024) to the Chandra X-ray light curve of M31*, the supermassive black hole at the center of M31, the Andromeda galaxy. Extending and expanding on the work in [ 28 ] , we show that M31* has remained in an elevated X-ray state from 2006 through at least 2016 (when regular Chandra monitoring ceased) and likely through 2024, with the most recent observations still showing an elevated X-ray flux.

arxiv-2508-04698.title: FaST: Feature-aware Sampling and Tuning for Personalized Preference Alignment with Limited Data
arxiv-2508-04698.description: Abstract LLM-powered conversational assistants are often deployed in a one-size-fits-all manner, which fails to accommodate individual user preferences. Recently, LLM personalization – tailoring models to align with specific user preferences – has gained increasing attention as a way to bridge this gap.

arxiv-2510-11228.title: Mean-field BSDEs with non-Lipschitz coefficients and double mean reflections
arxiv-2510-11228.creator: Hanwu Li, Jin Shi
arxiv-2510-11228.description: Abstract The present paper is devoted to the study of mean-field backward stochastic differential equations ( MFBSDEs ) with double mean reflections whose generators are not Lipschitz continuous. With the help of the Skorokhod problem and some a priori estimates for MFBSDEs, we establish the existence and uniqueness results for doubly mean reflected MFBSDEs .

arxiv-2602-03931.title: Orbi-Instantons and Class 𝒮 \mathcal{S} Theories of Type D
arxiv-2602-03931.creator: Hao Y. Zhang
arxiv-2602-03931.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Hao Y. Zhang. We investigate the landscape of 6d 𝒩 = ( 1 , 0 ) \mathcal{N}=(1,0) D-type orbi-instanton superconformal field theories (SCFTs) and their torus compactifications to four-dimensional class 𝒮 \mathcal{S} theories. By analysing a general class of 6d F-theory constructions via generalised quivers, we demonstrate that—in contrast to the well-characterised A-type series—the dimensional reductions that admit a 4d class 𝒮 \mathcal{S} description on a Riemann sphere with three untwisted D-type punctures constitute only a subset of the full orbi-instanton landscape.

pmc-11314531.description: Gastrointestinal disorders dysregulate the biochemical environment of the gastrointestinal tract by altering pH conditions during the gastric phase of digestion or by reducing the secretion of pancreatin during the intestinal part of the process. Ingested functional food could therefore lose some of its health-promoting potential apart from its nutritional value.

pmc-12429014.title: Sublethal Doxorubicin Promotes Extracellular Vesicle Biogenesis in A375 Melanoma Cells: Implications for Vesicle-Loaded TGF-β-Mediated Cancer Progression and Cardiovascular Pathophysiology
pmc-12429014.creator: Laura Fernanda Fernández-Fonseca, Susana Novoa-Herrán, Adriana Umaña-Pérez, Luis Alberto Gómez-Grosso
pmc-12429014.description: Doxorubicin (Dox) is not a first-line treatment for melanoma due to limited antitumor efficacy and dose-dependent cardiotoxicity. However, sublethal doses may trigger adaptive cellular responses that influence tumor progression and systemic toxicity. Small extracellular vesicles (EVs) are key mediators of intercellular communication and can carry bioactive molecules that modulate both the tumor microenvironment and distant tissues.

pmc-12516936.title: Dietary Nitrate Prevents Cardiac Dysfunction in HFrEF by Improving Hemodynamics, Ameliorating Remodeling, and Resolving Inflammation
pmc-12516936.creator: Miho Shimari, Gaia Picozzi, Ariela Boeder, Drielle Dantas Guimarães, Zhengbing Zhuge, Jon O. Lundberg, Mattias Carlstrom, Lars H. Lund, Daniel C. Andersson, Gianluigi Pironti
pmc-12516936.description: AimsImpaired cardiac function, reduced nitric oxide (NO) bioavailability, and inflammation are key contributors to the pathogenesis and progression of heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF). This study aimed to investigate whether dietary inorganic nitrate supplementation can attenuate cardiac dysfunction and adverse remodeling in HFrEF by enhancing NO signaling.

pmc-12517980.title: Results of a Randomized Controlled Trial Evaluating the Impact of Conversion to LCP Tacrolimus on Neurologic Toxicities in Liver Transplant Recipients
pmc-12517980.creator: Kelsey S. Coffman, Gonzalo J. Revuelta, Nathan DeTurk, Charles Palmer, Hannah Culpepper, Morgan Overstreet, James Fleming, Kathleen Terry, Neha Patel, John McGillicuddy, Santosh Nagaraju, Teresa C. Rice, David J. Taber
pmc-12517980.description: Background/AimsNeurotoxicity is commonly seen in liver transplant (LT) patients receiving tacrolimus. We sought to determine the impact of LCP tacrolimus on neurologic toxicity in LT recipients.MethodsThis single-center, semiblinded, parallel group randomized controlled trial compared neurotoxicity burden in LT patients receiving immediate-release (IR) tacrolimus versus LCP tacrolimus.
